def _stage_roles(stage, role):
    if stage == 'templates':return list(TEMPLATE_ROLES)
    if stage == 'manifest':return ['metadata_manifest']
    if stage == 'capture':return ['plan','capture_bound','metadata_binding']
    if stage == 'phase_bound' and role in PHASE_BOUND_ROLES:return [role]
    if stage == 'phase_binding':return ['phase_binding']
    raise ValueError('unknown exact M3 Source stage/role')

def splice_exact(raw, edits):
    need(type(raw) is bytes and type(edits) is list and bool(edits), 'finite actual nonempty Source span edits')
    edits = sorted(edits,key=lambda x:x['start_byte'])
    cursor,parts,proof,delta = 0,[],[],0
    for item in edits:
        need(set(item) == {'start_byte','end_byte','old','new'} and type(item['start_byte']) is int
            and type(item['end_byte']) is int and cursor <= item['start_byte'] < item['end_byte'] <= len(raw)
            and type(item['old']) is str and type(item['new']) is str
            and raw[item['start_byte']:item['end_byte']] == item['old'].encode('utf8'),
            'nonoverlapping exact old whole literal/assignment span')
        old,new = item['old'].encode('utf8'),item['new'].encode('utf8')
        start = item['start_byte']+delta
        proof.append(dict(item,selected_start_byte=start,selected_end_byte=start+len(new)))
        parts.extend((raw[cursor:item['start_byte']],new));cursor = item['end_byte'];delta += len(new)-len(old)
    parts.append(raw[cursor:]);result = b''.join(parts)
    reverse = result
    for item in reversed(proof):
        start,end = item['selected_start_byte'],item['selected_end_byte']
        need(reverse[start:end] == item['new'].encode('utf8'), 'exact selected span for whole Source inverse')
        reverse = reverse[:start]+item['old'].encode('utf8')+reverse[end:]
    need(reverse == raw, 'entire complete Source byte inverse; all complement bytes untouched')
    return result,proof

def safe_relative(value):
    need(type(value) is str and re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+',value) is not None
        and not value.startswith('/') and all(x not in ('','..','.') for x in value.split('/')),
        'ordinary finite Root-chosen relative identity only; no code/numeric predicate replacement')
    return value

def template_identity(role, old, inventory, rows, lease_pin, operational_choices):
    entry = inventory[role];slots = entry['literal_slots'];edits = []
    need(entry['available_basis'] == rows[role]['predecessor'] and sha(old) == entry['available_basis']['sha256'],
        'actual inventory binds complete current template Source')
    operational = {slot['value'] for slot in slots if slot['kind'] == 'separate_unselected_operational_path'}
    need(type(operational_choices) is dict and set(operational_choices) == operational,
        'exact closed Root-chosen operational filename identities, never actual operational records')
    for slot in slots:
        old_literal = slot['raw_literal'];value = slot['value']
        need(old[slot['start_byte']:slot['end_byte']] == old_literal.encode(), 'actual inventoried literal byte boundaries')
        if slot['kind'] == 'future_lease_leaf':
            selected = Path(lease_pin['path']).name
        elif slot['kind'] == 'selected_family_literal_reference':
            target = Path(rows[slot['referenced_role']]['canonical_path'])
            selected = target.relative_to(BASE).as_posix() if '/' in value else target.name
        elif slot['kind'] == 'separate_unselected_operational_path':
            selected = operational_choices[value]
        else:
            raise ValueError('uninventoried literal transformation kind')
        safe_relative(selected)
        need(type(selected) is type(value), 'same original literal type')
        new_literal = repr(selected) if role == 'capture_template' else "'"+selected+"'"
        if selected != value:
            edits.append(dict(start_byte=slot['start_byte'],end_byte=slot['end_byte'],old=old_literal,new=new_literal))
    need(bool(edits), 'selected successor actually changes Source identity bytes')
    result,proof = splice_exact(old,edits)
    if role == 'capture_template':
        tree = ast.parse(old); literals = {(n.lineno,n.col_offset,ast.literal_eval(n)) for n in ast.walk(tree)
            if isinstance(n,ast.Constant) and type(n.value) is str}
        need(bool(literals), 'actual Python Source literals parsed as data only')
        restored = result
        for item in reversed(proof):
            restored = restored[:item['selected_start_byte']]+item['old'].encode()+restored[item['selected_end_byte']:]
        need(functions(restored) == functions(old) and protected_assignments(restored) == protected_assignments(old),
            'all original Python functions/guards/owner/timestamp assignments retained by exact identity inverse')
        nodes = assignments(result)
        need(all(ast.literal_eval(nodes[x].value) is None for x in CAPTURE_SLOTS if x != 'BINDINGS')
            and len(ast.literal_eval(nodes['BINDINGS'].value)) == 9
            and all(x is None for x in ast.literal_eval(nodes['BINDINGS'].value).values()), 'capture six slots/nine binding cells remain unbound')
        ast.parse(result)
    else:
        need(result.count(b'$BoundScriptSha256 = $null') == 1 and result.count(b'$BoundReviewSha256 = $null') == 1,
            'two phase assignment slots remain original null; no Parser execution')
    return result,proof

def immutable_json(old, new, changed_keys):
    need(set(old) == set(new), 'original closed JSON ABI retained')
    need(all(old[key] == new[key] for key in old if key not in changed_keys), 'all original JSON fields outside dependency cells retained')
    reverse = copy.deepcopy(new)
    for key in changed_keys:
        reverse[key] = copy.deepcopy(old[key])
    need(reverse == old, 'exact original decoded JSON reconstruction')

def json_artifact(role, old_raw, value, fields, rows, proof):
    old = strict_source_json(old_raw)
    need(wire(old) == old_raw, 'complete original JSON wire identity; no hidden formatting normalization')
    immutable_json(old,value,fields)
    restored = copy.deepcopy(value)
    for key in fields:
        restored[key] = copy.deepcopy(old[key])
    need(wire(restored) == old_raw, 'whole original JSON byte inverse')
    proof = dict(proof,changed_top_level_fields=sorted(fields),original_fields={key:old[key] for key in sorted(fields)},
        complete_current_predecessor_byte_inverse=True)
    return pack(role,wire(value),old_raw,rows[role]['predecessor'],rows,proof)

def capture_assignment_bind(template, values):
    need(set(values) == set(CAPTURE_SLOTS), 'exact original six capture assignments')
    nodes = assignments(template);offsets = [0]
    for line in template.splitlines(keepends=True):offsets.append(offsets[-1]+len(line))
    edits = []
    for name in CAPTURE_SLOTS:
        node = nodes[name]
        old_value = ast.literal_eval(node.value)
        need((name == 'BINDINGS' and type(old_value) is dict and set(old_value) == BINDING_KEYS
            and all(x is None for x in old_value.values())) or (name != 'BINDINGS' and old_value is None),
            'original capture template unbound slots retained before binding')
        start,end = offsets[node.lineno-1]+node.col_offset,offsets[node.end_lineno-1]+node.end_col_offset
        edits.append(dict(start_byte=start,end_byte=end,old=template[start:end].decode(),new=name+' = '+repr(values[name])))
    result,proof = splice_exact(template,edits)
    need(functions(result) == functions(template) and protected_assignments(result) == protected_assignments(template),
        'all original capture functions/classes/guards/protected assignments exact outside six slots')
    ast.parse(result)
    return result,proof

def old_bound_template_inverse(old_bound, old_template):
    b,t = assignments(old_bound),assignments(old_template);bo,to = [0],[0]
    for line in old_bound.splitlines(keepends=True):bo.append(bo[-1]+len(line))
    for line in old_template.splitlines(keepends=True):to.append(to[-1]+len(line))
    edits = []
    for name in CAPTURE_SLOTS:
        bn,tn = b[name],t[name]
        bs,be = bo[bn.lineno-1]+bn.col_offset,bo[bn.end_lineno-1]+bn.end_col_offset
        ts,te = to[tn.lineno-1]+tn.col_offset,to[tn.end_lineno-1]+tn.end_col_offset
        edits.append(dict(start_byte=bs,end_byte=be,old=old_bound[bs:be].decode(),new=old_template[ts:te].decode()))
    restored,proof = splice_exact(old_bound,edits)
    need(restored == old_template and functions(old_bound) == functions(old_template),
        'actual whole predecessor BOUND six-assignment inverse to current predecessor TEMPLATE')
    return proof

def phase_predecessor_inverse(old_bound, old_template):
    restored = old_bound
    for name in ('BoundScriptSha256','BoundReviewSha256'):
        pattern = rb'^\$'+name.encode()+rb" = '[a-f0-9]{64}'$"
        matches = list(re.finditer(pattern,restored,re.M))
        need(len(matches) == 1, 'actual previous single digest-bound phase assignment')
        match = matches[0]
        restored = restored[:match.start()]+('$'+name+' = $null').encode()+restored[match.end():]
    need(restored == old_template, 'complete original phase BOUND two-literal predecessor inverse')
    return True

    need(role in GENERATED_ROLES and role not in PEER_ROLES and type(raw) is bytes
        and 0 < len(raw) <= row['source_cap'] and sha(raw) != row['predecessor']['sha256'],
        'finite changed selected Source only; no peer synthesis/cap relaxation')
    need(read_pin(diff_basis_pin,cap=row['source_cap']) == diff_basis_raw, 'actual exact removed-byte diff basis, no false oldBOUND header claim')
    return dict(role=role,raw=raw,proof=proof,diff_basis=diff_basis_pin,diff_basis_raw=diff_basis_raw)
